thread:
maya: Heads-up — noticed duplicate side-effects in the payments sampleapp during onboarding. Seems to happen when token rotation coincides with a 429 and the client retries. Repro steps below.
jack: Oof. How often are you hitting it? any logs?
maya: ~30% of runs in CI repro. Quick log snip:
```
WARN request=tx-7f3b 429 -> retry attempt=1
WARN request=tx-7f3b retry_after=0.5s
INFO request=tx-7f3b retry attempt=2 -> got 200
INFO request=tx-7f3b processed -> created charge id=ch_01
WARN request=tx-7f3b duplicate processed? created charge id=ch_02
```
jack: Hmm both retries produced 200 and created distinct charge ids? That implies server processed the second request as new. Do we send any idempotency key from the SDK/sampleapp?
maya: No — sampleapp just reuses a generated client-generated id in body for app-level dedupe but not using an HTTP Idempotency-Key header. Code excerpt:
```js
// sampleapp payments call
await client.post('/charges', {amount, currency, request_id: uuid()})
// no idempotency header set
```
sam: My guess: token rotation triggers a short period where the SDK refreshes tokens. One of the retries gets through with the old token (or a stale route) and the other with the new token — both end up being processed. Since we rely on body-level request_id and it's regenerated on retry, server can't dedupe. Two quick mitigations: 1) ensure client preserves request_id across retries (same id per logical operation), 2) SDK adds an Idempotency-Key header automatically for mutating endpoints (or expose it explicitly).
jack: Agreed on preserving request_id. But adding a default Idempotency-Key header by SDK is a bit opinionated. We need privacy/compliance check (some tokens/headers logged). Maybe default to enabled but with an opt-out flag? Also need to set a safe replay window server-side.
maya: For onboarding friction, easiest short-term fix: sampleapp should pass a stable request_id stored in the retry context. I'll open a tiny patch. Long-term: Sam's SDK suggestion sounds good.
ops-bot: CI job payments-integration #412 finished (repro-run) — 2 failures, 1 duplicate charge detected by test-harness.
sam: Also worth tuning backoff/jitter: current SDK uses fixed 250ms base with cap 2s. When token rotation happens the window is ~300–800ms; chaotic synchronous retries fall within that window. Proposal: change default base to 500ms and use full jitter: delay = random(0, base * 2^attempt). That spreads retries out and lowers contention. Add a "safeReplayWindowMs" config for server teams to set dedupe TTL.
jack: Love the jitter change. For the Idempotency-Key default we should: (a) make it enabled by default for mutating endpoints (b) document telemetry and retention (c) let enterprise disable via config. That balances DX vs compliance.
maya: Action items: I'll update sampleapp to preserve request_id across retries and add a short note in onboarding doc about token-rotation edge. Sam — can you draft SDK PR for auto Idempotency-Key + jitter change? I'll link the repro in the PR. I'll also add a short e2e test that asserts no duplicate charges when retrying during token rotation.
sam: Yep — I’ll draft the PR and tag eng-ml + security for header retention review. Will include opt-out flag `sdk.autoIdempotency=false` and config `sdk.backoff.strategy=full_jitter base_ms=500`.
jack: Ping me on the PR for compliance sign-off. If we get consensus we'll ship small patch to sampleapp and then roll SDK in canary.
maya: Thanks team — opening PRs now and will reference this thread.
